skills.name: arc:audit
skills.description: Read-only evaluation (只读) that produces ranked, evidence-backed code findings and never edits code: review any diff, PR or branch (代码评审, 能不能合), project health, code rot, over-engineering and tech debt (体检, 技术债, 过度设计, 可删代码), HTTP API design review (接口设计, 上传约束, JSON字段限制), AppSec audit, threat model and source-first pen test (威胁建模, 渗透测试) across web, identity, client, cloud, CI, RPC, mobile and LLM-agent surfaces, secret, dependency and SAST scans (安全扫描, Semgrep, 漏洞), and authorized DAST. Business lifecycle gaps (状态机漏洞, 闭环检查) go to arc:plan model mode. Not for fixes (use arc:code), tests (use arc:verify), or posting comments on CNB pull requests (use cnb).

skills.name: arc:code
skills.description: Every task that changes source code: write code to implement (写代码, 实现, 开发功能, 落地改动) a feature, endpoint or page (前端, 落地页, 要好看, shadcn, 小程序) on the project's stack; fix (修复) a bug, error (报错), incident or failing test by evidence-first root-cause repair (根因); refactor (重构) or migrate; change an API or schema; apply Go backend layering (DIP, usecase, 分层); write comments (注释); add timing probes to a Gin SSR path (计时, 探针, 埋点); or build TypeSafe classifiers and routers (分类器, 意图识别). Implements an existing DESIGN.md. Ends with the gate.sh completion check. Not for read-only review (use arc:audit), tests as the deliverable or release evidence (use arc:verify), PRDs, task docs or closure models (use arc:plan), visual direction without code (use ui-design), or commit, push and PR delivery (use check).

skills.name: arc:verify
skills.description: Proves business code meets business expectations: business-flow inventories and flowcharts tracing branches to cases (业务流, 端到端业务流, 分支覆盖), test plans (测试方案, 用例设计, 测试范围), write tests (写测试), test-first acceptance tests (测试先行, TDD), test-value review (测试价值), regression and browser E2E suites (网页实测), coverage (覆盖率), fuzz campaigns (模糊测试), property and model-based tests (属性测试, 模型一致性), SQL lint gates (SQL 语法检查), transaction design per engine (事务设计), reliability checks (可靠性, 业务不变量) for transactions and concurrency (事务并发), idempotency (幂等), faults and recovery; PostgreSQL release qualification (G0-G31); flaky-test triage; load tests (压测); and release go/no-go gates (发布验收, 发布证据). skills.name: arc:vet
skills.description: Open-source due diligence before a new dependency or a non-trivial generic component (开源选型, 技术选型, 引入依赖, 不要重复造轮子, build vs buy): checks existing code and the standard library first, compares at least three GitHub candidates, verifies substantive maintenance, stable releases, license compatibility (许可证), advisories, transitive dependencies and integration cost with dated source links, rejects archived or 36-month-stale libraries (停更) unless an evidenced exception is recorded, and writes a decision record (选型记录): reuse, adopt, borrow the design, or build. Also re-vets a named dependency or finds a successor. Not for implementing the chosen option (use arc:code), dependency vulnerability scans (use arc:audit), or research articles (use research-write).

intent_router.Condition: A named dependency in use is stale, archived, relicensed or vulnerable; find a successor (停更, 换库)
